title: Compactification realization of the finite tower pairing
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$, a finite-field datum $D$ with algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic $p\ne\ell$, and a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$. Fix the compactification $a=pj:X\to Z\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites and the quotient sequence rings $\mathcal Q_W(n,U)=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_W(U)$. Use the completed coefficient sheaves, strict R-module tower category, separately derived proper image, exact open extension and point sections of [def-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing-constructions]. Let $Q$ be any strict cochain complex of quotient-system modules on $X$, with given isomorphisms $eQ_n:Q_n\cong\omega_n$ to the finite dualizing objects [lem-coef-finite-dualizing].
There exist a coherent derived-system calculus $S$, a pairing system $G$ on the fixed compactification and finite frames $F_n$ (the adjunctions and tensor comparisons in [def-coef-tower-evaluation-pairing-constructions]). Write $H(K)=\operatorname{Sections}^{\rm Tow}R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal Q_X}(S.K,Q)$, $B(K)=\operatorname{Sections}^{\rm Tow}F^{\mathcal Q}(S.K)$, and $B_Q=\operatorname{Sections}^{\rm Tow}F^{\mathcal Q}Q$, all restricted to R. There are natural isomorphisms $t_n:\operatorname{ev}_n(H\otimes_R^LB)\cong\operatorname{ev}_nH\otimes_R^L\operatorname{ev}_nB$, $eH_n:\operatorname{ev}_nH(K)\cong R\Gamma(X,R\mathcal Hom_{A_n}(K_n,\omega_n))$, $eB_n:\operatorname{ev}_nB(K)\cong R\Gamma(s,F_nK_n)$ and $eQcompact_n:\operatorname{ev}_nB_Q\cong R\Gamma(s,F_n\omega_n)$. Here $A_n=R/\varpi^{n+1}$, $K_n$ is actual derived scalar extension, and the tensor comparison $t_n$ is an isomorphism of tensor bifunctors for all tower objects. For every K and $n\le m$, $\operatorname{ev}_{m\to n}B(K)$ followed by $eB_n$ equals $eB_m$ followed by integral sections of compact support of the actual quotient-restriction transition $K_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n$. For every finite-Tor constructible integral K and every n, $\operatorname{ev}_n(G.\beta_K)$ followed by $eQcompact_n$ equals $t_n$ followed by $eH_n\otimes eB_n$ and the finite frame pairing. The latter is precisely R-to-$A_n$ scalar balancing, the finite sections and proper projection mates, the inverse open tensor comparison, and closed evaluation after the source sections counit. No trace, inverse limit, Hom representative calculation or dinaturality is asserted.
